pull.title: KAFKA-17351: Improved handling of compacted topics in share partition (2/N)
pull.body:
This PR addresses a problem with fetching data from `compacted` topics.  The issue arose when an entire batch disappeared from the topic log, but the same batch was still marked as available in the Share Partition state cache.  Because subsequent reads wouldn't retrieve the missing batch, it will remain as available in the cache.

The PR checks the base offset of the first fetched/read batch. If this offset is greater than the position where the read began (the fetch offset), and there are any `available` batches in the state cache, those batches are then archived.

Adds following test cases:
1. `testAcquireAndAcknowledgeWithRecordsAheadOfRecordBatchStartOffset` - Added to verify the existing code for compacted topics.
2. `testAcquireWhenBatchesAreRemovedFromBetweenInSubsequentFetchData` - Added to verify the existing code for compacted topics.
3. `testAcquireWhenBatchesRemovedForFetchOffset` - Verifies the changes in the current PR.
4. `testAcquireWhenBatchesRemovedForFetchOffsetWithinBatch` - Verifies the changes in the current PR.
5. `testAcquireWhenBatchesRemovedForFetchOffsetForSameCachedBatch` - Verifies the changes in the current PR.
